text: August exports rose 25% y/y and imports 28.2%, below the 30% estimate. The trade surplus reached $119.09B. U.S.-bound exports rose 34.4%, while domestic demand and investment remained weak.

meta.note: Import and export growth are both elevated, while their relative balance remains asymmetric.

text: Novartis reported a failed Phase III del-desiran trial after pelacarsen missed its endpoint and eight rap-cel trials were paused following three patient deaths. Shares fell 8.9%. Del-desiran entered the pipeline through the $12B Avidity acquisition.

meta.note: The three setbacks span separate programs and therapeutic areas.

text: Two Phase III trials showed tozorakimab reduced moderate and severe COPD flare-ups across current and former smokers and multiple eosinophil levels. The drug is under FDA priority review, with regulatory reviews also underway in the EU and China.

meta.note: No head-to-head trials establish its relative position against existing COPD biologics.

text: Qualcomm and AWS established a multi-generation custom-silicon partnership for AI infrastructure. Amazon received warrants for 25M Qualcomm shares at $161.26, with tranches linked to commercial arrangements and purchases of up to $60B in Qualcomm technology.

meta.note: Warrant vesting remains conditional on specified commercial arrangements and procurement levels.

text: LIV Golf filed for Chapter 11 under a restructuring agreement with BC Partners Credit. PIF funding is set to end after the 2026 schedule, with $49.6M in bankruptcy financing provided during proceedings. Majority player ownership remains under discussion.

meta.note: Post-bankruptcy ownership and financing remain subject to court approval and unresolved agreements.
